title: Bijstandsaanvraag
description: The Participatiewet benefit application case type: statuses from the old participatiewetZaak lifecycle, roles, results, its fields (the household situation and the asset and income tests flagged sensitive, kept in the case's sensitiveProperties) and a published flow. Handled by dossiq-sociaal-domein, confidential. Installed on every instance, as the participatiewetZaak schema and its seeds were. Its record import moves every stored participatiewetZaak onto a case on upgrade: the BSN to subjectBsn, the case number kept as a former reference and used to join duplicate rows into one case, consents and re-integration trajectories pointing at the record moved onto the case, the record stamped with migratedTo and migratedAt.
